Name: Tool Seller
Author: AgentLyoko
Description:
This is a fairly simple mod, so there won't be too much of a description. That said, the basic details are as follows:

[center][b]WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
[/b][/center]By default, this mod lets you get a spare set of tools from Clint for the low, low price of 1000g per spare tool. You can upgrade them to Iridium as you would your original tools, and use them instead of your upgraded tools while Clint's upgrading them. It also allows extra tools to be purchased from the Volcano Dwarf once you've unlocked them, since more than two of a tool normally means you're wanting to get the tools with enchantments - but be warned that tools from the Dwarf will be significantly more expensive!

[center][b]﻿What if I want to just buy tools from Clint for cheap?

[/b][/center]Sure! You can swap to "blacksmith" mode in the config and Clint will sell unlimited of a (basic) tool for 1000g. A steal, to be sure.
[center]﻿
[b]I don't want to get easy tools, but I do want to get more. Can I get a version with just the Volcano Dwarf selling them?[/b][/center]
Sure! Just swap to Dwarf mode. The tools will only be patched into the Volcano Dwarf's shop at that premium.

[center][b]Why does this need Stardew Valley 1.6? Can't you make this mod work in 1.5.6?[/b]﻿[/center]
Unfortunately, due to how item IDs and shops work in 1.6 versus 1.5.6, I can't actually put any tools for sale at Clint's without heavy C# coding rather than a simple Content Patcher mod I could make in 15 minutes (with extra bonus features in a few extra). 

[center]﻿[b]Wait, is that it?[/b][/center]
Yep. You'll get a mail from Clint upon install detailing that you can get the new tools (unless set to Dwarf Mode). Otherwise, that's all there is to this mod. Have fun!

If you'd like to translate the mod, please ask first! The mod is i18ned so I am very willing to have translations, but I would also prefer to be informed of translations of my mods.

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/116553368]atravita[/url] for helping with the creation of this mod (and the idea for offering extra tools at the Dwarf!)
